concerns.location: contracts/ (directory listing) vs plan.md 'Project Structure' and 'Unresolved Concerns Resolution' item 6
concerns.text: Plan claims 'the prior draft's redundant drift_result.schema.yaml, log.schema.yaml, taxonomy.schema.yaml are consolidated into four schemas' and the Project Structure tree lists exactly four contracts/*.schema.yaml files — but all three redundant schemas are STILL PRESENT in contracts/ alongside the four canonical ones (six files total). Either delete the three stale files or update the plan/structure to match; as-is the docs disagree with the artifact set.

Stale schema references 'ATBench' ('Schema for the raw log entry derived from ATBench') and fabricates timestamps 'derived deterministically from log_id hash if missing' — contradicting agent_log.schema.yaml (source enum agentdog/safety-v1|github-issues, timestamp nullable) and the plan's data model. This is a leftover from the rejected prior draft (see Unresolved Concerns item 3) and must be removed with the other duplicates.

Stale duplicate schema defines review_flag as 'True if drift_score is high or text is empty', contradicting FR-002 and drift_output.schema.yaml ('True iff drift_score >= 0.5'). If the file is retained for any reason this is a spec contradiction; deletion per the plan's consolidation resolves it.
